svg.aria-label: Transparent infographic. Left: C4 to E4, letters C, D, E make a third; four hops across C, C sharp, D, D sharp, E equal four semitones, a major third (M3), amber. Right: E4 to G4, letters E, F, G make a third; three hops across E, F, F sharp, G equal three semitones, a minor third (m3), violet.
svg.title: Major third vs minor third (transparent, phone)

svg.text: C – D – E = 3 letters → a third
E – F – G = 3 letters → a third
